blocks.summary: J1 (+5V_TERM, terminal) + J2 (USB_VBUS, usb) OR-ed by D1, D2 (SS34) onto VSYS_5V; 0.43 A worst (usb-only), diode loss ≤ 0.157 W each
VSYS_5V 4.59–4.73 V → +3V3 3.318 V synchronous buck (SY8089A1AAC), 0.521 A peak / 0.113 A typical, η 90%, loss 0.198 W
ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 RF/MCU module on +3V3: 0.101 A typical, 0.501 A peak (1.659 W)
CH340C USB↔UART bridge on +3V3 (20 mA peak); UART U0RXD/U0TXD
J2 (USB3.1TYPE-C16P): CC1, CC2, USB_DM, USB_DP, USB_VBUS; CC pull-downs R3 5.1kΩ, R4 5.1kΩ (USB-C sink Rd → default USB power)
D3 (USBLC6-2SC6) ESD array on USB_DM, USB_DP, USB_VBUS
LED1 (KT-0805Y) indicator driven from U3.IO2 (LED_CTRL) via R7 1kΩ, 1.399 mA
Q1/Q2 (MMBT3904(RANGE:100-300)) auto-download: DTR/RTS drive EN/IO0 for automatic flashing
momentary keys SW1 → IO0, SW2 → EN; C7 1uF RC, R5 10kΩ pull, R6 10kΩ pull

Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 datasheet v1.x: RF current table — Rx 802.11b/g/n ≈ 88–97 mA (typ 0.1 A used as Wi-Fi-connected average); Tx 802.11b 1 Mbps @ 21 dBm ≈ 355 mA; 'Power Supply' — the external supply should provide ≥ 0.5 A (peak 0.5 A used). GPIO max source 40 mA (ESP32-S3 series datasheet, DC characteristics).

assumptions: DC operating point (MNA + Newton-Raphson): capacitors open, inductors = DCR, switching regulators averaged by power balance; not a transient simulation
IC signal pins are high-impedance (no DC drive) unless a GPIO drives an LED network
loads are constant-current above a knee voltage and resistive below it (unpowered rails draw nothing)
J1: input source +5V_TERM = 5.00 V (net name) with 0.02 Ω series resistance
J2: input source USB_VBUS = 5.00 V (model) with 0.1 Ω series resistance
momentary switches are released (open) except in buttons-pressed
U3.IO2 (LED_CTRL) assumed driven high (LED1 on) through 40 Ω output resistance
SW1 closed: momentary switch pressed in buttons-pressed
SW2 closed: momentary switch pressed in buttons-pressed
J2 (usb) disconnected in terminal-only
J1 (terminal) disconnected in usb-only

via R = ρ·h/(π·(d+t)·t), plating t = 0.7 mil, h = layer spacing (board thickness / (layers−1))
planes and pours = resistive sheet grid (pitch ≥ 25 mil, ≤ 6000 cells) over the region outline; antipads and other nets' copper are not subtracted (optimistic)

each supply (power: source part ≥ 5 % of the largest; ground: the return entry, kind connector-source when marked) is solved as the sole reference; other pads draw (+I) or feed (−I) their simulated current; per-segment currents and per-pad drops are the maxima over these cases (a merged worst-case file does not satisfy KCL)
trunk segments (carrying a case's whole load) carry at least the supplying pin's own current; capacitor pads with ripple RMS keep the width that current needs
isolation: 标准 IPC-2221B：0 对绝缘要求，0 个铣槽，0 个禁铺区，0 条间距/爬电问题

thermal.label: 能量平衡
thermal.note: Σ 对流散热 = Σ 热源

assumptions: copper from the board dump: tracks/arcs = 1-D resistors ρL/(w·t) split at junctions/vias/pads and at every cell; poured fills, static fills, planes = sheet cells G = (t/ρ)·min(harmonic coverage, shared-edge copper fraction); pads shorted to the sheet they overlap
ρ = 1.72e-08 Ω·m (20 °C); via barrel R = ρ·h/(π(d+t)t), plating t = 0.7 mil, h = layer-centre distance

stackup: TOP 35.0 µm @ z 0.018 mm; IN1 17.5 µm @ z 0.254 mm; IN2 17.5 µm @ z 1.346 mm; BOTTOM 35.0 µm @ z 1.583 mm; dielectrics [0.2104 1.0742 0.2104] mm (JLC04161H-7628 (4-layer 1.6 mm, L1→L2 7628 prepreg 0.2104 mm))

each scenario of the sim file is solved on its own (KCL-consistent): the supplying part (power: source pins; ground: return entry, connector-source first) is the 0 V reference, every other pad draws (+I) or feeds (−I) its simulated current; worst = maximum over scenarios
via ampacity = IPC-2221 external curve on the barrel cross-section π(d+t)t at ΔT 10 °C (IPC-2152: internal ≈ external)

thermal: per layer k_Cu 385 W/mK × t × coverage + FR-4 0.3 W/mK in-plane over half of each adjacent dielectric; FR-4 0.3 W/mK through-plane + via barrels; convection top/bottom; part heat on its pads by area; Joule heat from the DC solve; board edges adiabatic; part bodies do not convect separately (their top face shares the board's h)
Tj = board temperature under the part + P·θJB (θJC when only that is rated); without a rating only the board temperature is reported
2 through-hole pad(s) carry no drill in the dump: plated hole assumed = 0.5 × the smaller pad side
80 thermal-relief spoke(s) of the poured copper modelled as tracks of their stroke width

IN1 has no copper objects in the dump (a negative/内电层 plane is not listed by pcb dump): assumed a solid GND plane — board outline inset 30 mil (copper-to-edge), antipads around every other-net via / THT pad / cutout = its copper + 6.0 mil clearance, same-net vias connect directly (thermal-relief spokes ignored). Override with --plane 15=NET or --plane 15=none
boundary: the bare board in still air — natural convection on both faces (top 10.0, bottom 10.0 W/m²K), no enclosure, fan or airflow (no CFD); board edges adiabatic

steps.title: 目检
steps.action: 放大镜/AOI 检查极性与方向件：D1, D2, D3, LED1, Q1, Q2, U1, U2, U3；细间距与 EP 器件检查连锡、立碑、少锡
steps.expect: 极性/1 脚全部与丝印一致，无连锡
steps.ifFail: 返修后重新目检，禁止带缺陷上电

steps.title: 断电短路检查
steps.action: 万用表欧姆档，红表笔接各电源轨、黑表笔接 GND（见下表）
steps.expect: 每条轨 > 100 Ω，数值与下表已知路径同量级
steps.ifFail: < 10 Ω：按电源树从源头逐段断开（拆 0 Ω/电感/二极管）定位短路

steps.title: 限流上电
steps.action: 可调电源接其中一路输入（J1(+5V_TERM), J2(USB_VBUS)，逐路验证），限流 69.24 mA（1.5× 典型），电压从 0 缓升到标称
steps.expect: 空载/典型电流 ≈ 46.16 mA（仿真 typical），无器件发热
steps.ifFail: 电流顶到限流：立即断电，回到第 2 步；局部发热用热像/手触定位

steps.title: 测量各电源轨
steps.action: 按 §8 测试点计划逐条测量，从上游到下游：+5V_TERM → USB_VBUS → VSYS_5V → +3V3

steps.title: 开关电源波形
steps.action: 示波器接地弹簧测开关节点与输出纹波（§8）
steps.expect: 占空比与仿真一致，纹波在估算量级
steps.ifFail: 占空比异常/间歇工作：检查反馈分压、电感焊接、输入电容

steps.title: 功能与接口
steps.action: 按 §8 测接口枚举、复位/启动键、指示灯
steps.ifFail: 接口失败先查差分对焊接与 CC/上下拉电阻值

steps.title: 带载 / 峰值
steps.action: 运行峰值负载固件（如射频发射），记录输入电流与各轨最低电压
steps.expect: 输入电流 ≈ 0.43 A（仿真峰值场景），各轨不跌出容差
steps.ifFail: 跌落：检查 IR 压降路径（§6）与输入源能力

signatures.cause: 电源轨短路 / 极性件反贴 / IC 方向错
signatures.check: 断电测各轨对地电阻；目检极性件

signatures.symptom: 降压输出 0 V，输入正常
signatures.cause: EN 未拉高 / 电感虚焊 / 芯片未起振
signatures.check: 测 EN 电平与开关节点波形

signatures.symptom: 降压输出 ≈ 输入电压
signatures.cause: 反馈分压开路或阻值错（FB 悬空）
signatures.check: 测 FB 电压应 ≈ Vref；核对分压电阻

signatures.cause: 输出电容虚焊或容值不足（DC 偏压）/ 电感饱和
signatures.check: 测纹波与电感电流；核对 §4 电感余量

signatures.symptom: 系统电压比输入低 > 0.5 V
signatures.cause: OR 二极管 Vf 高于模型 / 走线压降
signatures.check: 测二极管两端压差，对照 §3 Vf

signatures.cause: D+/D− 焊接或交换 / Type-C CC 下拉缺失 / 桥接芯片未供电
signatures.check: 测 VBUS、CC 电阻值、桥接芯片供电与晶振

signatures.cause: LED 反贴 / 驱动脚未输出 / 限流电阻错
signatures.check: 二极管档测 LED 方向；测驱动脚电平

glossary.label: 余量 Margin
glossary.value: (额定 − 应力)/额定 × 100 %；下限类检查为 (工作值 − 下限)/工作值

glossary.label: IR 压降
glossary.value: 直流电流在走线/过孔/平面电阻上的电压降

glossary.label: Ipk / Irms
glossary.value: 开关电源电感电流峰值 / 有效值

glossary.label: Isat
glossary.value: 电感饱和电流：电感量下降到规定比例时的电流

glossary.label: VRWM
glossary.value: TVS/ESD 反向工作电压（不导通的最高电压）

glossary.label: VRRM
glossary.value: 二极管最大重复反向电压

glossary.label: DC 偏压
glossary.value: II 类 MLCC 在直流电压下有效容量下降的现象

glossary.label: 爬电距离 / 电气间隙
glossary.value: 沿绝缘表面 / 空气中两导体的最短距离

glossary.label: TDR
glossary.value: 时域反射计：测量传输线阻抗

glossary.label: EP
glossary.value: 器件底部裸露散热/接地焊盘
